summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of all new features in 58:12 Global Connect CRM. Tested: sidebar navigation sections, dashboard financial stats, notification bell, global search, Financial page, Sales & Products POS, Families & People, Locations, Audit Trail, and Calendar iCal export. All 10 new features pass end-to-end testing.

minor.issue: Net Balance on Financial page shows 'UGX 0' (In: UGX 260,000 / Out: UGX 260,000) while Dashboard shows 'UGX 38,000' for the same endpoint at different load times. Monthly Expenses showed 25,000 on Financial page after adding an expense with no date, vs 27,000 on Dashboard. Expenses without a date field may be excluded from monthly calculations.

integration_issues.issue: Seed data locations (Entebbe Branch, Jinja Chapter) appear flat/unindented instead of being nested under '58:12 Global Centre' (Main). The code correctly implements ml-8 indentation for branches with matching parent_id, but the seed data branches appear as 'orphaned' because parent_id doesn't match the Main location's ID. Need to verify seed data has proper parent_id links.

Date field in Add Donation and Add Expense modals defaults to empty string. Expenses/donations added without a date may not appear in monthly statistics. Forms should default date to today's date for better UX.

issues: 3 'API Test Event' entries appear in Upcoming Events list (from previous API testing) - not a design issue but seed/test data noise

action_items: Verify seed data for Locations has proper parent_id links to show hierarchical indentation (Main > Branch > Sub-location)
Consider defaulting date input to today in Add Donation/Expense forms so monthly stats are correctly populated
Clean up duplicate 'API Test Event' entries from previous backend testing
critical_code_review_comments: Financial page net_balance calculation inconsistency between Financial page and Dashboard - both call same endpoint but show different values. May be a timing/caching issue or different data snapshots.
Expense/Donation forms with empty date may cause data to be excluded from monthly stats - consider defaulting to today's date
Location hierarchical display is code-correct but depends on proper seed data parent_id linkage
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing: 1 donation (Test Donor, UGX 5,000), 1 expense (Test Expense, UGX 2,000), 1 family (Test Family), 1 location (Test Location), 1 sale (2 Month Old Chicken x2, UGX 40,000 - invoice inv_06DA7003)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 new features tested and working. Sidebar nav sections (People/Ministry/Finance/Admin), dashboard financial cards, notification bell with mark-all-read, global search with Ctrl+K, Financial page tabs+forms, Sales POS with cart+receipt, People page families/children/guests, Locations page CRUD, Audit Trail with pagination, Calendar iCal export. Minor: Locations seed data needs parent_id fix for hierarchy. Date fields in financial forms should default to today. Backend APIs confirmed working for all endpoints tested.
